title: Under Armour Announces Stephanie Linnartz as President and CEO
summary: Stephanie Linnartz will join Under Armour as President, Chief Executive Officer, and member of its Board of Directors, effective February 27, 2023.
body_text: “As a 25-year veteran of one of the world’s most respected global companies, we are thrilled to welcome Stephanie to the brand,” said Kevin Plank, Under Armour Executive Chair and Brand Chief. “She is a proven growth leader with a distinguished track record of brand strategy, omnichannel execution, talent acquisition and development, and passion for driving best-in-class consumer connectivity, experience, and brand loyalty." Plank continued, “Responsible for leading Marriott’s multi-billion dollar digital transformation, driving scale through continuous brand innovation across the portfolio, developing premier sports league and team partnerships, while architecting the extraordinary growth of its loyalty program – the board is confident that Stephanie – along with our leadership team and all of our key stakeholders – will accelerate our ability to realize the substantial opportunities for Under Armour as both an operating company and aspirational brand.” Upon Linnartz joining the company, Colin Browne, who has served as interim President and CEO since June 2022, will continue in a leadership role by resuming his position as Chief Operating Officer. Plank commented, “Colin is a world-class industry professional and has done a terrific job leading throughout the transition. Highlights include refining our long-term strategy by tripling our total addressable market, validating the renewed growth fundamentals necessary to establish sector leadership, and championing our UA team culture. The board and the entire organization are grateful for his continued leadership and are fortunate to have such an important partner for Stephanie.” Linnartz said, “Under Armour is an iconic brand with a huge opportunity ahead. This company has immense energy and excitement, and I am committed to building growth while maintaining operational excellence. I look forward to joining the incredible UA team, partnering with Kevin and the board, and leading this amazing company into its next chapter, delivering for athletes, teammates, customers, and shareholders.” Stephanie Linnartz – Additional Background Linnartz has served as President of Marriott International, Inc. since 2021. In this role, she is responsible for providing strategic leadership for all aspects of Marriott’s global strategy, including brand management, sales (including e-commerce), marketing, revenue management, customer engagement, information technology, digital functions, and emerging businesses. She also oversees the company’s Marriott Bonvoy® loyalty platform, global hotel development, operations services, and design organizations, and its progress on issues, including the intersection of technology and hospitality and environmental sustainability. She is currently leading a significant technology transformation program to deliver a better customer experience, drive more topline revenue, and support more efficient operations. She has also developed successful multi-year marquee partnerships with the NFL, NCAA, and the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team. From 2020 to 2021, she served as Group President, Consumer Operations, Technology & Emerging Businesses and as Executive Vice President and Global Chief Commercial Officer from 2013 to 2019. Before that, she held various executive roles in sales, marketing, and finance. Linnartz is a member of The Home Depot’s Board of Directors, the world's largest home improvement specialty retailer with approximately 2,300 stores and 500,000 associates. Linnartz has been recognized for her industry leadership, including being named to the Forbes CEO Next 2021 list. She is also a member of the Fortune CEO Initiative, a forum of global corporate leaders committed to addressing major social issues. About Under Armour, Inc. Under Armour, Inc., headquartered in Baltimore, Maryland, is a leading inventor, marketer, and distributor of branded athletic performance apparel, footwear, and accessories. Designed to empower human performance, Under Armour’s innovative products and experiences are engineered to make athletes better. For further information, please visit http://about.underarmour.com. title: How M3G Achieves Safety & Schedule Certainty with Resolve Coordination
body_text: Project Types: Food & Beverage, Chemical Processing Facilities M3G specializes in engineering design for food, beverage, pharmaceutical, and chemical facilities across South America for clients like Proctor & Gamble, Nestle, Mondelez, Unilever, and other top brands. Their goal is to help clients design functional facilities and get them to production as fast as possible. They recently turned to Resolve to accelerate their project delivery and improve confidence in their coordination process. One issue alone helped prevent 3 weeks of startup delay at a food production plant. With Resolve, model reviews became simple and portable—enabling engineering teams to collaborate directly with owners onsite and remotely, without IT support or model prep. “If you have a one-month project deadline, Resolve helps you finish within the month and with fewer issues.” — Mauricio Gouvea, CEO, M3G MEP Coordination with Clarity and Predictability Resolve’s platform has transformed M3G’s coordination process. Engineering teams can perform virtual inspections with owner O&M teams accelerating approvals, eliminating rework, and reducing costly delays. Previously, setting up a VR session required days of preparation, file conversions, and technical expertise. Now, M3G is able to leverage Resolve’s desktop and VR viewers to collaborate with owners and catch issues early. From equipment layouts to safety hazards, teams are able to stay on schedule and avoid redesigns. Key Issue Avoided: Insufficient visibility for food safety monitoring In one facility walkthrough, Resolve revealed that there was insufficient visibility for monitoring process areas. This would have blocked inspections by the safety and quality team, requiring major late redesigns. Instead, M3G was able to update the design to include more visibility windows preventing up to a 3 week delay in startup! Stay on Schedule with Confidence Resolve helps M3G ensure that when a model is approved, it’s final. With Resolve, M3G has been able to more quickly identify designs that don’t align with food safety specifications or client maintenance requirements. This helps avoid production delays. “With Resolve, M3G is improving collaboration with clients and facility operators. And our teams find it very easy to use.” — Fabio Pinto, IT Manager, M3G An M3G piping designer reviews a model for safety and operability issues Coordinate Beyond Clashes With Resolve, M3G is able to collaborate with more stakeholders, from operations to safety, to capture high quality feedback. Resolve has transformed their coordination process so they can more easily address safety and compliance needs. Simplified Setup, Broader Collaboration M3G eliminated the need for IT-managed workflows with Resolve. What used to take hours of file prep and office coordination now takes minutes, enabling engineers to review models directly with clients across desktops and VR headsets. By combining all parts of the platform, the M3G team aligns faster, resolves more issues, and completes projects with greater confidence. Resolve helped M3G streamline model reviews across stakeholders, reduce reliance on IT, and deliver better outcomes for industrial clients—all while avoiding rework and keeping production schedules on track. title: Kforce opens AI & Innovation Studio to help clients prove AI value before they scale
summary: Read how the Kforce Innovation Experience helps clients move from AI exploration to execution through hands-on collaboration.
body_text: Kforce opens AI & Innovation Studio to help clients prove AI value before they scale As part of the Kforce Innovation Experience, clients can validate AI use cases, prioritize investments and move forward with solutions shown to deliver real business value. TAMPA, FL (April 23, 2026) — Kforce’s AI & Innovation Studio is now open, giving leaders an in-person environment to work through real business challenges and determine where innovation will deliver measurable results. Inside the studio, clients work alongside Kforce experts and domain practitioners to design, test and refine real-world AI solutions. The Tampa studio is the cornerstone of the Kforce Innovation Experience , a proven engagement model that helps organizations move beyond experimentation to credible, evidence-backed outcomes. Clients pressure-test ideas in real time, interact with working solutions and identify which AI investments deliver business value. Clients can also engage with the Kforce Innovation Experience through Regional Innovation Hubs, Idea-to-Outcome Workshops and the global AI Center of Excellence. Together, these components support hands-on ideation, rapid prototyping and solution refinement. Clients collaborate with Kforce technologists, architects and industry practitioners to minimize decision risk and understand how solutions come together before broader adoption. Teams leave with tangible artifacts, including prioritized AI investment roadmaps, clickable prototypes, architecture direction and early validation of feasibility, value and risk. “The heart of the AI & Innovation Studio is the ability to make AI real,” said Kforce Consulting Solutions Vice President Brad Boyd, who leads the firm’s data and AI practice. “We’re not talking about ideas in isolation. Here, clients can see, touch and manipulate solutions in a controlled environment. They leave with a clearer understanding of how these pieces come together to support their strategy.” Sessions are engineered to help leaders evaluate which investments deliver real-world value in their industry and operating context. Client teams are introduced to Kforce accelerators: prebuilt frameworks and solution components informed by prior client work and industry validation. These accelerators help organizations move faster by applying proven approaches tailored to their environments. Assets already created through this experience include the AI Value Realization Engine, which connects AI initiatives to business outcomes, prioritizes investments and aligns stakeholders. For organizations looking to turn AI ideas into practical, scalable outcomes, the Kforce Innovation Experience provides a trusted environment to validate value, reduce risk and move forward with confidence. About the Kforce Innovation Experience This curated engagement model includes four components that guide clients in unlocking AI value. Kforce AI & Innovation Studio Located at our headquarters in Tampa. Dedicated to deep dives, rapid prototyping and live solution development aligned to industry-specific challenges. Regional Innovation Hubs 30 nationwide hubs established within our field office network for hands-on collaboration and custom solutions creation, tailored to regional and industry realities. Idea-to-Outcome Workshops Kforce experts visit client offices to determine where AI delivers practical business value within their industry. Global AI Center of Excellence Where the work comes to life. Our experts in Pune expand prototypes, strengthen architecture and prepare solutions to scale responsibly across client enterprises. About Kforce Kforce is a solutions firm specializing in technology, finance and accounting, and professional staffing services. Our KNOWLEDGEforce® empowers top companies to achieve their digital transformation goals. We curate teams of technical experts who deliver solutions custom-tailored to each client’s needs. These scalable, flexible outcomes are shaped by deep market knowledge, thought leadership and our multi-industry expertise. Our integrated approach is rooted in 60 years of proven success deploying highly skilled professionals on a temporary and direct-hire basis. Each year, approximately 17,000 talented experts work with the Fortune 500 and other leading companies. Together, we deliver Great Results Through Strategic Partnership and Knowledge Sharing®. title: Carrier Abound Earns Three E+E Leader Awards, Advancing AI-Driven Building Performance at Scale

Discover how Carrier Abound is advancing building performance at scale.

The solutions and services enable building management to see deeply and broadly across their assets, prioritize and act on real-time insights, and refine, adapt, and scale on a continual basis to improve energy efficiency and asset performance, enhance occupant comfort and productivity, and streamline compliance reporting. title: Master Affiliate Marketing Content for GroMo Partners in 2026
summary: Boost your GroMo commissions with effective affiliate marketing content strategies. Learn to create trust-driven, high-converting material in 2026.
body_text: Affiliate marketing content is the material that actually gets people to buy the blogs, videos, WhatsApp forwards, and reels that convince someone to click your link. Without it, even the best financial products just sit there. With it, a single GroMo Partner can turn a credit card link into ₹2,400 in commission, repeated dozens of times a month. It's July 2026. India's fintech distribution space is crowded. Thousands of new GroMo Partners join every week hoping to earn through referrals, but most struggle. It's rarely the products that are the problem. It's usually that their content is weak, generic, or invisible. Here’s how to fix that. What Is Affiliate Marketing Content? It's any material you create to push a product using a trackable referral link. Blog posts, short videos, social captions, WhatsApp forwards, comparison guides. The job is simple: build enough trust to get the click that turns into a sale. You don't need a marketing budget or a design team. A GroMo Partner selling the SBI Credit Card or Kotak 811 App can record a 30-second Instagram reel explaining the benefits, drop the link in their bio, and start earning commissions the same week. The content does the selling it works 24/7, answers objections, and builds credibility before the customer ever talks to you. If you're new to how this works, it helps to understand the structure first. Our guide on what is an affiliate program and how GroMo partnerships work covers the backend; this one is purely about making content that earns. Why Content Quality Directly Impacts Your Commission Content quality is the difference between a lead trusting you enough to click and ignoring you completely. Weak content gets scrolled past. Strong content answers doubts before they're even asked. Consider two GroMo Partners pushing the same Axis Flipkart Credit Card. One shares a bare link with "apply now." The other posts a quick comparison showing cashback benefits, eligibility, and a personal story about how the card helped with online shopping. The second partner converts three times more leads because the content did the heavy lifting. This is doubly true for high-payout products like personal loans or demat accounts, where customers need more hand-holding. Good affiliate content cuts down the manual "convincing" work you'd otherwise have to do yourself. That’s why top earners on GroMo treat content creation as seriously as they treat finding zero-investment business ideas in India . Types of Affiliate Marketing Content That Actually Work Different products need different formats. Here’s a breakdown GroMo Partners actually use: Content Type Best For Why It Works Short-form video (Reels/Shorts) Credit cards, savings accounts High reach, builds trust fast WhatsApp broadcast messages Loans, EMI cards Direct, personal, high conversion Comparison blog posts Demat accounts, investments Helps undecided buyers choose Story-based testimonials Any product Builds emotional trust FAQ-style carousels Complex products (loans, mutual funds) Clears doubts in one scroll "Instant deal" style content (think Story TV or Airtel Xstream) works well as a hook. It grabs attention even if it's not your main earner. Use it to build an audience, then steer them toward higher-payout products like SBM Novio or HDFC Pixel Play. Start Creating Content That Earns Download GroMo Now Building a Content Calendar Around GroMo Products A calendar keeps you consistent instead of random. Plan weekly, mixing beginner-friendly products with high-conversion items so your audience sees variety without feeling spammed. A simple weekly structure works: Monday – Educational post (e.g., "How to improve your credit score" linking to our credit score improvement guide ) Wednesday – Product spotlight (e.g., Kotak 811 App or Tide Business Account) Friday – Testimonial or success story from a customer you helped Sunday – FAQ or myth-busting content (e.g., addressing loan app scam fears using our RBI-approved loan apps guide ) This rhythm keeps engagement up without fatigue. According to internal GroMo partner data, those who post consistently for 90 days typically see 2-3x more leads than those who post sporadically. Compliance: The Non-Negotiable Part of Affiliate Content Compliance stops your commission from getting clawed back. Every piece of content must be accurate no misleading claims about guaranteed approvals or hidden fees. This matters for products like personal loans, which carry a first-3-EMI clawback clause, or Aditya Birla Mutual Fund SIPs, which require 3 months of maintenance before payout. If your content promises "guaranteed loan approval" for a product that checks CIBIL scores, you risk complaints and losing your payout. Before writing, check: Is the payout locked behind a training module? Are there clawback conditions? Are you targeting the right profile? (Don't pitch SBI Credit Card to someone who fits SBM Novio better). Being upfront "approval depends on CIBIL and income eligibility" actually builds more trust than overselling. Partners who understand personal loans without income proof know how to phrase eligibility honestly without scaring off real leads. Repurposing Content Across Platforms Repurposing is getting more mileage out of one idea. A single WhatsApp message can become an Instagram caption, a YouTube Short script, and a blog snippet in minutes. Say you write a 200-word explainer on why the Swiggy HDFC Credit Card suits daily spenders. You can: Turn it into a 30-second video script. Pull three lines for a WhatsApp status. Use it as a caption under a screenshot of the cashback screen. Post it as a community forum answer. This multiplies reach without multiplying effort. Many successful GroMo Partners in Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities (similar to strategies in our zero-investment income ideas for Tamil Nadu piece) rely on repurposed WhatsApp content because it requires zero editing skills. Using Data and Social Proof in Your Content Data beats opinion. Numbers like "60 lakh+ partners" or "₹100 crores paid out" work because they are specific and verifiable. When creating content, lean on GroMo’s track record: 60 lakh+ active partners across India ₹100 crores collectively earned by the partner community 68,000+ positive reviews validating the platform Mentioning these numbers especially in captions or video intros reassures skeptical leads that you aren't pushing a random scheme. This is effective for audiences unfamiliar with commission-based selling, like first-time earners exploring remote jobs in India with GroMo . Join 60 Lakh+ Partners Download GroMo Today Avoiding Common Content Mistakes Most affiliate content fails because of avoidable mistakes, not bad luck. Recognizing these early saves months of wasted effort. Common pitfalls include: Overpromising : Claiming "100% guaranteed approval" for products that need eligibility checks. Ignoring audience fit : Pitching premium credit cards to audiences who need secured cards like IDFC WOW Black. Posting once and forgetting : Content needs repetition to sink in. Skipping training : Many products are compliance-gated; your content can't go live properly until you finish GroMo's certification. Avoiding these mistakes is often the difference between earning ₹5,000 a month and crossing six figures, similar to patterns seen in our ₹1 lakh monthly earning strategies article. Final Thoughts Affiliate marketing content isn't optional decoration. It's the engine of commission-based income on platforms like GroMo. The partners earning the most in 2026 aren't necessarily the most experienced; they're the ones creating consistent, honest, well-targeted content week after week. Start small. Pick one product, understand its eligibility and compliance rules, and create three pieces of content this week. Track which format gets the most clicks, then double down. Over time, this habit becomes your most reliable income asset one that doesn't need capital, just consistency. Frequently Asked Questions Q: Do I need professional editing skills to create affiliate marketing content for GroMo? A: No. Simple, honest content often beats polished ads. A clear WhatsApp message or a basic phone-recorded video explaining product benefits works well, especially for products like Kotak 811 App or Airtel Payments Bank. Q: How often should I post affiliate content to see real earnings? A: Consistency matters more than frequency. Posting 3-4 times a week for at least 90 days typically shows measurable improvement in leads compared to sporadic posting. Q: Can I promote multiple GroMo products in the same piece of content? A: Yes, but it's better to lead with one primary product and mention a secondary one briefly. Mixing too many products in one post can confuse the audience and lower conversion rates. Q: What happens if my content makes a false claim about a product? A: This can lead to customer complaints, application rejections, or clawback of your commission, especially for compliance-sensitive products like personal loans or mutual funds. Always state eligibility conditions clearly. Q: Is affiliate marketing content different from regular social media content? A: Yes. Affiliate content is built around a specific trackable link and a clear call-to-action, unlike general social posts. Its success is measured by clicks and conversions, not just likes or views. Q: Where can I learn more about how GroMo's affiliate structure works before creating content? A: Start with our detailed breakdown on what is an affiliate program and how GroMo partnerships work , which explains the referral and payout structure in depth.
